script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune, your ruling planet of the Water element, is locked in a harsh square to Mercury retrograding through your 6th House of work and health. This friction clouds contracts and daily routines with illusion. In love, Venus trines your 5th House of romance from the 1st, so singles attract dreamy admirers by showing vulnerability. Taken Pisces must watch secretive moods spark petty clashes. Career-wise, that Mercury square threatens delayed payments in the 6th, so recheck invoices before noon. Blessing: a surprise refund lands in your account by dusk. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
